Regression curls: /api/health, /api/lattice/state, /api/introspect, /api/memory/recall, /api/chat all 200; /api/perception/frame returns 200 when called with correct schema field name 'image_data' (not 'frame_b64'). Command history: typed /help, transmitted, then ArrowUp in chat-input repopulated value to '/help'. Autocomplete: typing '/gro' shows data-testid=autocomplete-ghost (1 element) with continuation 'w' suggesting '/grow'. /clear emptied scrollback and printed '[SYS] scrollback purged.' /grow harmonic kinetic typed in chat produced [GROWTH /<slug>] message AND auto-switched center deck back from neural to growth tab via onSwitchTab. Regression: vision-toggle still toggles (label changes), memory drawer opens via open-memory-btn, all 4 legacy tabs (observe/network/connect/neural) still clickable. No console errors — only benign WebGL ReadPixels + THREE.Clock deprecation + Canvas2D willReadFrequently warnings (carried over from prior iterations).
critical_code_review_comments: /app/frontend/src/components/ChatConsole.jsx is now 1107 lines — over the 700-line guideline. Consider splitting into ChatConsole.jsx (shell + form), useSlashCommands.js (the big command handler switch), useTerminalHistory.js (history + autocomplete hook), and MessageRow.jsx. Future maintenance and HMR will benefit.

/app/backend/routers/growth.py:_invent_capability — if Claude returns the same slug as an existing one, code appends a 4-char uuid suffix (line 320). Good. But the slug uniqueness check is racy across concurrent autonomous spawns (no unique index on althea_capabilities.slug). Low risk because of the 120s cooldown gate, but consider an explicit unique index on slug to make the invariant hard.

/app/backend/routers/growth.py:execute_capability — the 'invocations' counter returned (line 237) is computed as cap_doc.get('invocations',0)+1 in memory; if two executes race, both can return the same count. Either re-read after $inc with find_one_and_update(return_document=AFTER), or document that the returned count is best-effort.

/app/backend/routers/growth.py:list_capabilities sorts by timestamp desc but timestamp is stored as ISO string; lexicographic sort on ISO-8601 with timezone is generally correct, but mixing naive and tz-aware writes from different code paths could break ordering. All current write paths use .isoformat() on tz-aware datetime — fine, but worth a comment.

/app/backend/routers/perception.py:PerceptionFrame expects key 'image_data', not 'frame_b64' — keep the OpenAPI doc / test fixtures consistent so future agents don't reproduce the 422 I hit on the first regression curl.

ChatConsole '/clear' autocomplete ghost: when input is '/clear' (exact match) the ghost should not render — verified behavior is correct (ghost only shown when suggestion strictly starts with and is longer than input).

GrowthScreen does not poll /api/growth/capabilities — relies on App.js's autonomous poller. Acceptable, but a manual user-spawn from a SECOND tab will not appear until the poller fires (every 60s). Consider a local refresh after growth-spawn-btn click for instant feedback (currently it does refresh — verified card appeared within ~5s).
seed_data_creation: Test capabilities created during run ('playwright-sdet-probe' + one /grow-spawned faculty + autonomous-cooldown test caps). Cleanup is automatic via the test_iter14.py module fixture (delete /api/growth/capabilities on teardown). UI-spawned caps were not cleaned but are harmless and visible in the AUTOPOIESIS tab.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter14 regression suite: /app/backend/tests/test_iter14.py (9 tests, ~21s). The autocomplete-ghost element only renders when the suggestion strictly extends the input (input is shorter than suggestion); the visible text shown is suggestion.slice(input.length) — so for input '/gro' the ghost inner text is 'w', NOT '/grow'. Assert on data-testid=autocomplete-ghost count + that input+ghost concat equals '/grow', not on ghost text alone. The ASCII banner is rendered as a <pre data-testid=ascii-banner> element — note '/banner' also runs once on first boot via the /help (banner appears in scrollback), so locator.count() may be ≥1 even before user types /banner. The /grow slash command calls onSwitchTab('growth') after the backend responds (~3-15s depending on Claude latency) — be patient up to 25s. autonomous cooldown is 120s server-side; tests should run DELETE /api/growth/capabilities at setup to ensure a clean cooldown clock (deleting docs makes _last_autonomous_spawn return None).
rca of the issue: No bugs found in iter14. All 19 frontend acceptance criteria and all 9 backend pytest cases + 7 regression curls pass on first attempt.
